messages:
maria_ae: Quick kick-off: partner asked for a lightweight Ampere onramp refkit for GCP. Goal: terraform module + demo that provisions 1 GPU node and a simple inference service.

olga_b: I'll own the Terraform module and docs. plan to keep variables small: machine_type, node_count, node_arch, marketplace_tag.

tom_r: CI here. I'll add buildx multi-arch image build and a smoke deploy job. publish images to ghcr with tag from marketplace_tag.

eng_ops: please expose output `demo_ip` in the module so demo script can curl it. also include autoscaler.min/max defaults.

ci_bot: Workspace created: https://redwood-internal/partners/spaces/ampere-onramp. Checklist uploaded. :white_check_mark:

olga_b: Terraform example to include in repo:
```hcl
module "ampere_onramp" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/refkits//gcp/ampere-onramp"
  machine_type = "a2-highgpu-1g"
  node_count = 1
  node_arch = "arm64"
  marketplace_tag = "v1.0.0-ampere"
}
```

maria_ae: timeline: partner demo Wed. freeze artifacts Mon EOD. who needs help with quota requests?

tom_r: I'll request test quota and run a dry deploy Saturday. will post results here.

eng_ops: reminder: include KMS snippet in README and an example of routing to cpu-fallback in regions without GPUs.

maria_ae: great. sync tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar:
